reviews.notes: Domain heavily contaminated. 20 NaN group-label junk rows (mostly power generation ISCO 8182, plus dental/tires/metal) must be removed. Additional 9 real-aka rows are cross-domain (tobacco, power/utilities, gas filling, food/beverage packaging, generic packaging, wood/metal). Legit on-domain core (~12 roles, ISCO 8181 glass/ceramics/clay plant operators): tunnel kiln operator, auger press operator, glass polisher, drawing kiln operator, kiln firer, clay kiln burner, clay products dry kiln operator, glass annealer, fibre machine tender, brick and tile caster, dry press operator, glass forming machine operator. Multiple overlapping clay-kiln operator entries flagged as fan-out. Building-materials side (cement/refractory/concrete) is thin — could be strengthened but no fabricated adds.

reviews.notes: Assembly side is clean and coherent (ISCO 8211 machinery/vehicle assemblers, 8212 electrical/electronic assemblers, 8219 other product assemblers). Two problems: (1) 7 trailing NaN group-label junk rows to remove; (2) the domain is named 'Assembly, Packaging' but has NO packaging roles at all — packaging occupations (ISCO 8183) were wrongly scattered into D113. Added 3 core packaging roles to restore the packaging half. Mild ESCO fan-out on motor-vehicle assembler variants (vehicle/body/parts/engine) — all distinct ISCO 8211 occupations, flagged not removed.
